pr.title: Feat/windsurf
pr.body:
This pull request adds support for the Windsurf coding agent to the Conductor CLI, allowing users to select Windsurf as an agent during installation and generate the appropriate Conductor workflows and templates for it. The implementation includes updates to configuration, CLI prompts, generator logic, documentation, and automated tests to ensure seamless integration and maintain consistency with existing agent support.

**Windsurf Agent Integration:**

* Added `windsurf` to the `AgentType` union in `src/types.ts`, and updated agent configuration in `src/generators/config.ts` to include Windsurf-specific settings such as `agentDir: '.windsurf'` and `commandsDir: 'workflows'`. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-c54113cf61ec99691748a3890bfbeb00e10efb3f0a76f03a0fd9ec49072e410aL1-R1) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-1b167514c8640367dd2f13e3e75fe0a9fa0e2b39945cfd932632498247ee95dcR48-R53)
* Implemented `WindsurfGenerator` in `src/generators/WindsurfGenerator.ts` and updated the generator factory in `src/generators/index.ts` to handle Windsurf, ensuring generator selection logic and exports are consistent. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-83dccaf64f5322f6c3e061fa2677b616136dc31ebd96dafdc3bbbc200891ad70R1-R19) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-480d36a296821a122d6072387c7596eef4c123210e134f6d78d30d13472b2f82R10) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-480d36a296821a122d6072387c7596eef4c123210e134f6d78d30d13472b2f82R19) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-480d36a296821a122d6072387c7596eef4c123210e134f6d78d30d13472b2f82R33-R34)

**CLI and User Experience:**

* Updated the CLI agent selection prompt in `src/cli/prompt.ts` to include Windsurf as a selectable option, and ensured the `.npmignore` file includes `.windsurf/` and `.agent/` directories. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-238035d14f6d236b0017cc04bfe8b52e0eacf9f0ee465d3295d8313964cdbfd4R56-R60) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-34958b02363eec9a904716f0b4a8782b021c6b33b2e8599019e36c88e045240bR16-R17)

**Documentation Updates:**

* Added Windsurf to the list of supported agents in all user-facing documentation files, including `README.md`, `README_ja.md`, `README_ko.md`, `README_zh.md`, and `conductor/product.md`. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-b335630551682c19a781afebcf4d07bf978fb1f8ac04c6bf87428ed5106870f5R46) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-f352f176b719ca7e5c1025e2c75daa964dc961db4de4768a58a4b84fbee095b0R46) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-d3635ba904502881c51649dff0ba5918f0128837c0db93b9a0d8f6426d44de4dR46) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-bc53aca037f8d406f619f15cf2c5c905a7a61f81f89cab98dd52f7ff65725f6eR46) [[5]](diffhunk://#diff-e9dc8c4d48039d5d11f2d44268ece97bb0a900b26562288c020fa95ae517b61eL12-R18)
* Provided detailed specification and implementation plan for Windsurf support in `conductor/archive/windsurf_20260109/spec.md`, `plan.md`, and `metadata.json`. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-c9654d50a12310c49b02a35413697dc0f616700781d5bfd45171f7a858417115R1-R35) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-cc47244629b9d6dd9ba7226b5a4fb6cc6496f6ca6aa8fa39c50184bfced50499R1-R26) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-8b9048b833329dfac774eac5996ce5d3187c0f7ab7d94ebe2b22ce46ee1848c6R1-R8)

**Testing and Validation:**

* Added and updated tests to verify Windsurf integration: unit tests for the generator (`tests/generators/WindsurfGenerator.test.ts`), configuration (`tests/generators/config.test.ts`), agent type definition (`tests/agent-type.test.ts`), and CLI prompt options (`tests/prompt.test.ts`). [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-627b54412df0c4e35476344ee98119f875a14f4a8dbf76db1e670b71325aec2dR1-R59) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-ab89eb6e81113fbd9c416d0ed77c22b2a8724ad9784e901a0559e785430e9da4R43-R51) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-0d5a5498321c9646c8cf966550bd4f8e041ca4171eebcafe9f0f8bf87ade3416R16-R20) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-cf86211a9f97f99c50beda0bb05164ababaf12903a57833bb36e2d4070fa06f8L12-R12) [[5]](diffhunk://#diff-cf86211a9f97f99c50beda0bb05164ababaf12903a57833bb36e2d4070fa06f8R24-R36)

+# Track Specification: Windsurf Support
+
+## Overview
+Add support for Windsurf as a coding agent in the Conductor CLI. This will allow users to select "Windsurf" during installation, which will generate the necessary Conductor workflows as project-level slash commands for Windsurf (Cascade).
+
+## Functional Requirements
+1.  **CLI Agent Selection**:
+    -   Update the `install` command to include "Windsurf" as a selectable agent option.
+    -   Ensure "Windsurf" is available in the interactive prompt.
+
+2.  **Generator Implementation**:
+    -   Create a new `WindsurfGenerator` that scaffolds the Conductor files.
+    -   **Context**: Windsurf supports "Cascade" workflows defined in `.windsurf/workflows`.
+    -   **Configuration**:
+        -   `agentType`: `windsurf`
+        -   `agentDir`: `.windsurf`
+        -   `commandsDir`: `workflows`
+        -   `displayName`: `Windsurf`
+
+3.  **Installation Scope**:
+    -   Restrict to **Project** level installation only.
+
+4.  **Generated Artifacts**:
+    -   The generator should produce the standard suite of Conductor commands (`setup`, `newTrack`, `implement`, `status`, `revert`) within the `.windsurf/workflows` directory.
+    -   Conductor internal templates should reside in `.windsurf/conductor`.
+
+## Non-Functional Requirements
+-   Maintain consistency with existing generator patterns (`ConfigurableGenerator`).
+-   No new external dependencies.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+-   [ ] Running `conductor install` shows "Windsurf" in the agent list.
+-   [ ] Selecting "Windsurf" successfully generates files in `.windsurf/workflows` and `.windsurf/conductor`.
+-   [ ] The generated files follow the correct naming convention.
+-   [ ] `conductor install --agent windsurf` works as a shortcut.
